dedupe_keys.name: china s 15 year mine accident report dataset 2010 2025 532 structured official reports

description: A structured dataset built from 532 mine accident investigation reports published through official channels in China between 2010 and 2025. The Zenodo record says the reports went through data collection, standardised cleaning, structured annotation and quality validation, and are stored as JSON Lines; it covers 27 provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities, with 65.6 percent 'general' accidents and 20.3 percent roof accidents, and with Shanxi, Gansu and Inner Mongolia holding 11.7, 8.3 and 7.7 percent of accidents. Published on 19 October 2025 by Maoquan Wan, Hao Li, Hao Wang, Hanjun Gong (Chinese Institute of Coal Science) and Jie Hou, as one zip file of about 0.35 MB, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: it depends on which reports were published, the annotation scheme is not described on the page read, and it covers accident reports, not all incidents. For simulation it gives event records with causes and locations for accident causation models, regional risk warning and safety policy evaluation in the mining sector. A related catalogue record is the MSHA Mine Data Retrieval System for United States mine accidents.
